description: Checks the HTTPS setup of a public website in a few seconds: TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, trust, name), negotiated TLS version, redirect from HTTP to HTTPS and security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy). Returns the issues found, most severe first, and a link to the full graded SSL/TLS audit. Passive and non-intrusive: one TLS handshake and two page requests, like a browser visit.

domain.description: Host name of the website, e.g. "example.com" or "https://www.example.com/".

language.description: Language of the answer: "fr" for French, "en" for English (default). Use the language of the conversation.

name: check_ssl
title: Quick HTTPS / SSL check
